description_en: Queries the SourceModels in the current account
description_zh: 查询当前账户下的 SourceModel 列表
kebab_example: aliyun sls list-source-models --offset 0 --size 100 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --project-name example-project --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSourceModels

parameters.help_en: The start position of the query
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The number of SourceModels to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的 SourceModel 数量，取值范围为 1~500
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en: The region ID used for exact filtering
parameters.help_zh: 用于精确过滤的地域 ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The filter keyword for the project name. It is case-insensitive and matches substrings. Passing the full name also yields a match. If not specified, the results are not filtered by project name
parameters.help_zh: Project 名称的过滤关键词，大小写不敏感，按子串匹配（传完整名称也能命中）。不传表示不按 Project 名称过滤
parameters.name: project_name

schema.description_en: The response body. Returns the list of projects with enabled models in the current account
schema.description_zh: 响应体。返回当前账号下已启用模型的 Project 列表

count.description_en: The number of SourceModels returned in this request
count.description_zh: 本次返回的 SourceModel 数量
count.title_zh: 本次返回的 SourceModel 数量。

sourceModels.description_en: The list of models on the current page, sorted in descending order by last modified time. If no matching results are found or the page number is out of bounds, an empty array [] is returned
sourceModels.description_zh: 当前页的模型列表，按最后更新时间倒序排列；无匹配结果或页码越界时返回空数组 []

items.description_en: A single list item, which corresponds to a project with an enabled model
items.description_zh: 单个列表项，对应一个已启用模型的 Project

createTime.description_en: The creation time of the SourceModel. It is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
createTime.description_zh: SourceModel 的创建时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒
createTime.title_zh: SourceModel 的创建时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。

lastModifyTime.description_en: The last modified time of the SourceModel. It is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
lastModifyTime.description_zh: SourceModel 的最后修改时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒
lastModifyTime.title_zh: SourceModel 的最后修改时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。

project.description_en: The basic information of the project
project.description_zh: 该 Project 的基本信息

regionId.description_en: The region ID of the project

total.description_en: The total number of SourceModels that meet the query conditions
total.description_zh: 符合查询条件的 SourceModel 总数
total.title_zh: 符合查询条件的 SourceModel 总数。
